_meta.purpose: MOBILE-PREVIEW-4 (AWJ_APP_BUILDER_REAL_MOBILE_PREVIEW_HORIZON.md) — canonical, single-source list of every component/action identifier the shipped runtime actually implements. Component Registry parity (Horizon requirement #5: 'Verify Browser Preview coverage against runtime-supported component identifiers. No second independent component contract.') is a set-equality fact, not a rendering-detail fact — this fixture makes that set explicit and shared so drift in either allowlist fails a test immediately instead of being noticed later by a merchant.
_meta.note: mobile/test/registry/component_registry_test.dart already asserts ComponentRegistry.builders.keys == RuntimeCapabilities.components.keys (an internal Dart-only invariant); mobile/test/actions/app_action_test.dart already asserts decodeAction's recognized type set == RuntimeCapabilities.actions.keys. This fixture's own Dart consumer instead asserts RuntimeCapabilities' two maps against THIS file, closing the loop so a future capability bump only needs one shared edit reviewed on both sides, never a silent one-sided drift.
